_comment: Copy this file to hospitalIngestion.json (gitignored, like .env) and fill in real facilities as you onboard them. Each key is the exact hospitalID string used everywhere else in the app (the free-text 'Hospital ID' field on the Patient App / Clinician Portal / Admin Dashboard, and the hospitalID passed to POST /api/providers/register).

example-hospital-fhir._comment: See docs/fhir-adapter-live-emr-guide.md -- no config fields defined here yet, that guide's Section 5 covers per-hospital FHIR config separately.

example-hospital-manual._comment: No live integration at all -- staff use the Admin Dashboard's 'Hospital local patient roster' panel by hand (see docs/fhir-adapter-live-emr-guide.md Section 12, Option D).

general-hospital-langtang._comment: Optional production hardening: allowedIps = the interface engine's source addresses (all others are dropped); bindAddress = listen only on the VPN interface; fieldMap = where this hospital's feed puts each field, if it differs from the HL7 standard (keys: see DEFAULT_FIELD_MAP in src/services/hl7AdtListener.js).
